
== 0. preflight
  check: git, jq on PATH
  check: <T>/work/agentic-workflow is a git checkout with a clean tree whose HEAD is contained in origin/main or main (the code index never builds from another branch)
  check: ollama on PATH, answering on 127.0.0.1:11434, with the pinned model from context/code-index.lock
  check: the code-index graphify under <T>/state/cache/code-index/graphify-*, and bwrap (Linux) for its sandbox
  check: the pinned temporal binary under <T>/state/cache/bin/temporal-*
  check: nothing but this script's own plane listens on port 7481

== 1. scratch home <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun (port 7481)
+ mkdir -p <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun/profile && chmod 700 <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun && touch <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun/.first-run-scratch

== 2. profile that onboards agentic-workflow
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri profile init
+ append to <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun/profile/profile.yaml:
    | repos:
    |   - name: agentic-workflow
    |     path: <T>/work/agentic-workflow
    | services:
    |   context-docs-refresh: { every: 5m }
    | index:
    |   embeddings: { enabled: true }
    |   graph: { enabled: true }
    | context:
    |   publish: { waitForIndexMinutes: 15 }
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri profile validate --json
  check: profile validate gives a hash (exit 0 valid, 2 invalid)

== 3. profile (edits apply on save; nothing to approve)
+ nothing to approve: the profile written in step 2 is the live one

== 4. start the control plane
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri --headless
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri status --json
  check: status --json has running true (its exit code is 1 while health isn't healthy; that's fine)

== 5. first code index build for agentic-workflow
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri code-index status --repo agentic-workflow --json
  check: skip the build when that exits 0 (the repo's index is ok)
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri services run code-index-main-move
  check: the service starts the BuildCodeIndex job and the verb follows it; exit 0 succeeded
+ repeat 'AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri code-index status --repo agentic-workflow --json' every 10 s for up to 1800 s until it exits 0

== 6. publish the context map
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri context map status --json
  check: skip when .state is published, published-without-waiting or published-by-hand (no map is a non-zero exit)
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri context map refresh
  check: builds a draft, cleans the review queue and promotes it as you (no typed phrase); with the index built it is not held; exit 0
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 sindri context map status --json
  check: wait up to 1020 s (every 10 s) while .state is held or overdue (waitForIndexMinutes 15 plus two ticks); fail on published-stale or anything else

== 7. open the Sindri app on the scratch home (Context page)
+ AW_SINDRI_HOME=<T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun AW_SINDRI_PORT=7481 AW_SINDRI_APP_NO_MCP=1 <sindri-ui: $AW_SINDRI_UI, else <T>/state/bin/cs/current/sindri-ui> > <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun/logs/ui.log 2>&1 &
  check: the process is alive 2 s later; its pid is kept in <T>/state/sindri-app-firstrun/first-run/ui.pid

context-first-run up: done. Look at the app, then clean up with: scripts/context-first-run.sh down
